transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Monkey! You useless, flea-bitten ape! The horse is gone, the scripture-bags are gone, and the Master is weeping! You said you'd secure it before you left! Tripitaka is going to blame me, I just know it!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Calm down, Pigsy! This can't be helped. We must act quickly to find the horse and the provisions. I'll take to the skies to search for our lost items. You should comb the area around the camp to see if you can find any tracks. We have to work together to resolve this, not bicker.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Work together, huh? Easy for you to say, Wukong! Every time something goes wrong, I'm the one who gets the blame while you play hero! I'll check the area like you said, but if I find out it was your laxity that made us lose the horse, I won't let you hear the end of it. You better fly faster than the wind and bring something back, or Tripitaka's wrath will be the least of your worries!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'll make sure to search every nook and cranny of this blasted forest! Pigsy, don't stew in your烦闷. We can sort out the blame later; for now, let's focus on retrieving the horse and our supplies. I'll be quick as a streak of lightning, you can count on that. Now, let's get moving!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Alright, alright, Monkey, just get moving! I'll check for any signs around here, but if you don't come back soon, you'll find me roasting in my own frustration. transcript.text: Rest easy, Pigsy, I'll be back before you can say 'golden staff'! Keep your eyes on the ground; the horse is bound to have left a trail. transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Just get going, Monkey! I'll sniff out any footprints or clues that horse might have left. transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Now, now, Pigsy, you know I'm no turkey! I'll bring back the horse and the bags, don't you worry. Keep your snout to the ground and your eyes peeled. transcript.text: Your confidence better be worth something, Monkey! I'll keep my eyes and ears sharp as a hawk. Just swoop down quick if you see anything, and don't go chasing any shadows! transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'll be back in a flash, Pigsy! Keep your head up and your wits about you. If you see anything, don't hesitate to call out. transcript.speaker: antagonist

transcript.text: Fortune favors the bold, Pigsy! I'm not just winging it up here; I've got a plan.
